description: Frontend: add the MapLibre GL JS cell layer. Depends on FEAT-001 (consumes the regenerated typed client exposing GET /runs/{run_id}/cells). Add maplibre-gl (exact-pinned 4.x) + its CSS import, add getRunCells to the single integration point, build the CellMap component with the approved readability strategy (two-layer eligible/excluded split, data-driven styling, zoom LOD), wire it into AppShell replacing the region-interactive-map placeholder body to render the currently-loaded run, and update the shell tests (widen the integration-test mock, replace the placeholder-copy assertion, add CellMap.test.tsx) while preserving the four-region structure and the no-combobox/no-listbox rule. Grounded in design.md revision 3 §5 and design-review.md.
steps: Add the single integration-point operation in app/web/app/api/decision-service.ts: export `export type CellCollection = components['schemas']['CellCollection'];`; add `getRunCells(runId: string): Promise<CellCollection>;` to the DecisionService interface; implement it in createDecisionServiceClient in the identical style to getExclusions: `const { data, error, response } = await client.GET('/runs/{run_id}/cells', { params: { path: { run_id: runId } } }); if (data === undefined) throw new DecisionServiceError(response.status, error); return data;`. Never call fetch directly.

Install the map dependency: from app/web/ run `npm install maplibre-gl@4`, then edit app/web/package.json dependencies to pin the EXACT resolved 4.x version with NO caret/tilde (record whatever npm resolved; 4.7.1 is illustrative only). Commit the updated package.json and package-lock.json.

Add the MapLibre stylesheet side-effect import `import 'maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css';` to app/web/app/layout.tsx alongside the existing `import './globals.css';` (the single locked CSS strategy).

Add the map container styles to app/web/app/globals.css: `.om-map { height: 480px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--om-border); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; }` and `.om-map__status { padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--om-muted); }`.

Append the basemap env var to app/web/.env.example in the exact house comment style (design-review NIT-2): a comment block noting it is a browser-reachable XYZ raster tile URL, context only, public OSM is MVP/dev-only and must be overridden for deployed/non-trivial usage per OSM tile policy, then `NEXT_PUBLIC_BASEMAP_TILE_URL=https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png`. Add the matching row to the app/README.md environment-variables table and a line noting the interactive-map region now renders the Run's cells.

Create app/web/app/shell/CellMap.tsx ('use client') with props { runId: string | null; service: DecisionService }. The component fetches nothing on its own beyond service.getRunCells. Drive maplibregl.Map imperatively per design §5.3 with four single-purpose refs/state: mapRef (the Map), mapReady (state boolean, the only setData gate), pendingDataRef (replay buffer for data that arrived before load), requestIdRef (the only staleness guard). Mount effect []: create the Map on a container div (className 'om-map') with an NSW-framed initial view, an env-driven minimal inline raster style reading NEXT_PUBLIC_BASEMAP_TILE_URL with the required '© OpenStreetMap contributors' attribution, attributionControl: true, and a NavigationControl; on map.on('load') add an empty geojson source id 'cells' and the two circle layers, set mapReady=true, and if pendingDataRef.current apply it via setData then clear it; cleanup map.remove(). Data effect [runId, service, mapReady]: if runId is null render the no-run status and do nothing; else increment requestIdRef and capture myId, await service.getRunCells(runId), drop the response if myId !== requestIdRef.current, else if mapReady and the 'cells' source exists call source.setData(featureCollection) otherwise store it in pendingDataRef, and on reject (DecisionServiceError/network) set the error state only if myId is current — never crash the map.

Implement the §5.6 readability layers in CellMap (styling reads engine properties only, no decision math): layer cells-excluded (bottom) is a circle layer filtered ['==',['get','eligible'],false], muted single grey, small radius, low fill-opacity; layer cells-eligible (top) is a circle layer filtered ['==',['get','eligible'],true], fully opaque, larger radius, colour a data-driven interpolate ramp over ['get','suitability_score']. Add zoom-based LOD via interpolate ['linear'] ['zoom'] on circle-radius and circle-opacity (small/low at ~z5 state-wide, larger/higher at ~z9+). Distinguish eligible vs excluded on hue + opacity + radius (not colour alone). Clustering stays OFF. Read only ['get','eligible'] and ['get','suitability_score']; no coordinate transform and no cell_id parsing anywhere.

Add CellMap state/error UX: a loading status ('Loading cells…') while the fetch is in flight; on error a region status 'Map data unavailable: {message}' with role='alert' (the map container still mounts so the base map shows); on runId===null a 'No run is loaded.' status. Use the .om-map__status class for status text.

Wire CellMap into app/web/app/shell/AppShell.tsx: lift the built client into state `const [service, setService] = useState<DecisionService | null>(null)`, set in the SAME useEffect that currently assigns apiRef.current (keep apiRef for the existing run flow); pass service and engine?.run.run_id ?? null to CellMap. Replace the region-interactive-map PlaceholderRegion body with `service ? <CellMap runId={engine?.run.run_id ?? null} service={service} /> : (loadingText ?? 'No engine output is available.')`. Leave the PlaceholderRegion wrapper, its heading, and the four-region grid unchanged.

Update app/web/app/shell/AppShell.integration.test.tsx with the two mandatory edits: (a) add a getRunCells stub to serviceWithFlaggedDataset() (and any other DecisionService literal in the suite): `getRunCells: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({ type: 'FeatureCollection', run_id: 'run-wind-1', features: [] })` so the widened interface type-checks at all four call sites and CellMap has a resolved FeatureCollection at runtime; (b) remove the hard-asserted placeholder-copy line `expect(screen.getByText('2 ranked cells loaded from the engine; map rendering follows in S3-03a.')).toBeInTheDocument();` and instead assert the interactive-map region renders the CellMap container / mocked map.

Do NOT modify app/web/app/shell/AppShell.test.tsx: it renders <AppShell /> with no service prop, so createDecisionServiceClient() throws (no env), service state stays null, and CellMap never mounts there; it asserts only the four region labels, exactly four region landmarks, and no combobox/listbox/select. Do not add a service prop or a getRunCells stub to it.

Add app/web/app/shell/CellMap.test.tsx (Jest + Testing Library, maplibre-gl mocked because jsdom has no WebGL): assert that on a non-null runId the component calls service.getRunCells(runId) exactly once; that the returned FeatureCollection is passed to the mocked source's setData; that changing runId triggers a refetch; that an error renders the role='alert' 'Map data unavailable' message; and that the component never imports fetch directly (mirror the existing single-integration-point shell test style).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run typecheck` from app/web/ passes with the widened DecisionService (getRunCells required) and the new CellMap component.

`npm test -- --runInBand` from app/web/ passes: the updated AppShell.integration.test.tsx (getRunCells stubbed, placeholder-copy assertion replaced), the new CellMap.test.tsx, and the UNCHANGED AppShell.test.tsx (four region labels, exactly four region landmarks, no combobox/listbox/select).
`npm run build` from app/web/ succeeds (maplibre-gl + its CSS import resolve; Next.js build is clean).

CellMap renders the currently-loaded run's cells over an env-driven basemap, distinguishing eligible vs excluded on hue+opacity+radius, driven only by the served eligible/suitability_score properties; it reads data exclusively via service.getRunCells (no fetch literal, no coordinate math, no cell_id parsing).

maplibre-gl is pinned to an exact 4.x version (no caret) in package.json; the MapLibre CSS is imported once in layout.tsx; NEXT_PUBLIC_BASEMAP_TILE_URL is documented in .env.example and app/README.md.
verification: From app/web/: `npm test -- --runInBand` — all suites pass, including the unchanged AppShell.test.tsx four-region/no-selector assertions.

Runtime/visual check (manual, per design §5.8): with the stack running, the interactive-map region shows the NSW cell layer with eligible vs excluded clearly distinguished and readable at ~47k cells; not unit-testable.
findings:
FEAT-002 complete on branch s3-03a-map-rendering. All verification from app/web/ passed: `npm run typecheck` clean; `npm test -- --runInBand` = 7 suites / 71 tests pass (incl. the NEW CellMap.test.tsx, the updated AppShell.integration.test.tsx, and the UNCHANGED AppShell.test.tsx — four region labels, exactly four region landmarks, no combobox/listbox/select — verified byte-unchanged via `git diff --stat`); `npm run build` (with NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL set) succeeds, route / prerenders static.

RESOLVED FACTS FOR INTEGRATION/MERGE:

1. maplibre-gl RESOLVED VERSION: 4.7.1 — pinned EXACT (no caret/tilde) in app/web/package.json dependencies, installed with `npm install maplibre-gl@4 --save-exact`. package-lock.json updated and committed. `npm audit` reports 3 vulnerabilities (1 high, 2 critical) in maplibre-gl's transitive deps; NOT fixed because the ticket pins exact 4.x and `npm audit fix --force` would move off 4.x — flagged for the integration step to decide.

2. CSS import: `import 'maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css';` added once in app/web/app/layout.tsx, immediately above `import './globals.css';` (single locked CSS strategy, design §5.5).

3. BASEMAP ENV VAR: NEXT_PUBLIC_BASEMAP_TILE_URL added to app/web/.env.example (house comment block + default https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png) and to the app/README.md env-var table, plus a README line that the interactive-map region now renders the Run's cells. IMPORTANT DEVIATION FROM THE LITERAL STEP TEXT, forced by an existing guard: the __tests__/scope-guard.test.ts rule 'every hand-written app/ source contains no "https?://" literal' forbids baking the default OSM URL into CellMap.tsx. So the default lives ONLY in .env.example (per the project's 'no host literal in source' rule); CellMap reads NEXT_PUBLIC_BASEMAP_TILE_URL and, when it is unset, builds an empty style {version:8,sources:{},layers:[]} so the cell layer still renders over MapLibre's empty background (the design's non-blocking/graceful-degradation behaviour, §5.1). The required '© OpenStreetMap contributors' attribution is set on the raster source and surfaced by the AttributionControl. Net runtime behaviour matches the design; only the location of the default string differs. In dev/compose set NEXT_PUBLIC_BASEMAP_TILE_URL (it is in .env.example) to see tiles.

4. attributionControl: maplibre-gl 4.7.1's MapOptions type is `attributionControl?: false | AttributionControlOptions` — `true` does NOT type-check. Used `attributionControl: {}` (an options object), which enables the control (keeps the OSM attribution visible) and type-checks. Behaviourally equivalent to the design's `attributionControl: true`.

5. jest.setup.ts: added inert stubs for URL.createObjectURL / URL.revokeObjectURL. maplibre-gl touches these at import time and jsdom lacks them; AppShell.test.tsx and web-app-smoke.test.tsx import the real app (-> CellMap -> maplibre-gl) WITHOUT mocking it, so the module must at least load under jsdom even though the map never mounts there (no service => service state null => CellMap not rendered). No WebGL rendering happens in the suite. This was a reference-file edit, NOT a change to AppShell.test.tsx.

6. CellMap lifecycle note (design §5.3): data effect keyed [runId, service, mapReady]. To honour 'calls getRunCells exactly once per run' (§5.8) while keeping mapReady a dependency, the fetch is guarded by a fetchedRunRef so a mapReady re-run of the SAME run replays buffered data instead of refetching; requestIdRef remains the sole staleness guard (no separate 'active' flag). The resolve handler gates setData on the 'cells' SOURCE existing (equivalent to mapReady, since the load handler adds the source and sets mapReady together) to avoid a stale-closure miss. pendingDataRef is the sole replay buffer.

7. CellMap.test.tsx and AppShell.integration.test.tsx mock maplibre-gl (jsdom has no WebGL): the mock fires 'load' synchronously and exposes a shared setData spy. Manual/visual readability at ~47k cells against the running stack is NOT unit-tested (design §5.8), stated in the test file header.
